goal: Physically prevent the gate-impl anti-pattern of 'FAIL then re-run without any fix', keeping the retry ceiling as a budget dedicated to AI-judgement variance.
background: retry ceiling exhaustion from unchanged re-runs has been observed in multiple issue-logs (207-spec-json-primary, 207-overview-structured-merge, 203-next-action-cli, 204-unify-ai-prompt-style). The current gate-impl prompt only asks to 'fix and re-run' without requiring evidence of a fix, and run-gate.js has no mechanical guard against unchanged re-execution.

in: Add two MUST items to src/flow/prompts/impl/gate-impl.md (guidance layer)
Include headSha and worktreeHash fields in FAIL entries recorded by appendIssueLogFromGateResult in run-gate.js
Add a pre-AI rejection branch at the top of executeDiffBasedGate that compares the current state to the previous FAIL entry of the same phase and throws NO_PROGRESS_SINCE_LAST_FAIL on match
Skip gateRetry counter delta when rejection is caused by NO_PROGRESS_SINCE_LAST_FAIL
Unit tests covering the new behavior
out: Retry counter reset mechanism (already handled by spec 209)
Applying the guard to draft / spec / task-spec phases
Backfilling older FAIL entries without state identifiers

constraints: Node.js built-ins only; no new npm dependencies
alpha policy: no backward-compatibility shims; absent fields simply mean 'no prior state to compare'
Use crypto.createHash from Node built-ins to derive the worktree hash
Non-zero exit on NO_PROGRESS_SINCE_LAST_FAIL, same as ESCALATE_RETRY_EXHAUSTED
design_principles: Match the mental model of the existing retry counter (PASS resets, phase-scoped)
Rejection is neither FAIL nor PASS — do not consume the retry counter
State identifier = headSha + worktreeHash; both must match to consider the tree unchanged

modules.text: src/flow/lib/run-gate.js — add guard at top of executeDiffBasedGate; extend FAIL entry in appendIssueLogFromGateResult; add skipRetryCount handling

data_flow.text: gate-impl start: compute current headSha (git rev-parse HEAD) and worktreeHash (sha256 over git diff HEAD and git status --porcelain=v1 -z)
If last same-phase FAIL entry has matching headSha and worktreeHash, throw Error with code NO_PROGRESS_SINCE_LAST_FAIL before invoking the AI agent
Normal FAIL: appendIssueLogFromGateResult includes headSha and worktreeHash in the entry
Rejection result carries skipRetryCount so updateGateRetryCounter does not increment

decisions.text: Rejection carries err.code = 'NO_PROGRESS_SINCE_LAST_FAIL', following the shape of ESCALATE_RETRY_EXHAUSTED
If the last FAIL lacks state identifiers, do not reject (treat as no comparison data)
PASS entries naturally reset the scan: only the last FAIL after the last PASS is considered

requirements.desc: When gate-impl (phase task-impl or integration) ends in FAIL, the FAIL issue-log entry must include headSha and worktreeHash capturing the working tree state at the time of failure.
When `sdd-forge flow run gate --phase task-impl|integration` runs, compare the current headSha/worktreeHash with those of the latest same-phase FAIL entry before invoking the AI agent.

If the latest same-phase FAIL exists and both headSha and worktreeHash match the current values, throw Error with err.code = 'NO_PROGRESS_SINCE_LAST_FAIL' and a message that includes the previous FAIL reason and instructs the user to modify the spec/impl before retrying.
When NO_PROGRESS_SINCE_LAST_FAIL is raised, the gateRetry counter must not increment.
src/flow/prompts/impl/gate-impl.md must include a MUST stating that the AI records what was fixed (or the rationale for not fixing) before re-running gate.
src/flow/prompts/impl/gate-impl.md must include a MUST forbidding gate re-run when the working tree has not changed since the previous FAIL.
If the latest same-phase FAIL entry lacks headSha or worktreeHash, proceed to AI evaluation without rejection.
Only the latest FAIL entry after the latest PASS entry of the same phase is considered the 'previous FAIL'; PASS entries act as a natural reset for the guard.

acceptance_criteria: src/flow/prompts/impl/gate-impl.md contains two MUST items corresponding to REQ-5 and REQ-6
Unit test: FAIL entry records include headSha and worktreeHash
Unit test: same state as previous FAIL throws NO_PROGRESS_SINCE_LAST_FAIL before AI call
Unit test: rejection does not increase gateRetry (countGateRetry unchanged)
Unit test: missing state identifier on the previous FAIL results in normal AI evaluation
Unit test: PASS after a FAIL resets the guard so matching state does not reject

clarifications.q: Why not use git stash create to derive the worktree hash?
clarifications.a: git stash create has a side effect of creating a commit object; sha256 over `git diff HEAD` plus `git status --porcelain` is side-effect-free and equally discriminating.

clarifications.q: How is rejection surfaced to callers?
clarifications.a: Throw Error with err.code = 'NO_PROGRESS_SINCE_LAST_FAIL'. The flow envelope returns ok:false with errors[].code set accordingly, matching the shape of ESCALATE_RETRY_EXHAUSTED.

alternatives_considered.reason: Rejected — existing issue-logs show the AI skips the instruction in practice
Rejected — rejection reason does not reach the AI, so its next action is not guided
Rejected — would miss fixes that are not yet committed
